caption: The drawing features two detailed views of a round, gold-colored object, depicted as if made from metal. The object shown in the left-center appears as a circular piece with concentric rings and a central decorative pattern; it has two circular elements attached to its sides, and a semi-circular handle or ring is attached to these side elements, suggesting it is a door knocker or a similar fixture. To the right of this front view, there is a side (profile) view of the same object, revealing the depth and thickness of the plate and handle. Both objects are rendered in shades of brown and gold to indicate metallic material. The objects are centered on a beige background enclosed by a thin rectangular border. In the lower left corner, there is a linear scale marked 0 to 2, and in the lower right corner, the name "P. Johnson" is inscribed.
title: Drawer Pull
